title: Workflow orchestration and durable execution
summary: Turning steps into repeatable, retryable pipelines: Airflow for ML and for data (with Dagster), the ML-native orchestrators, and Temporal.
intro: Workflow orchestration is the layer that turns individual steps such as ingestion, feature computation, training, evaluation and deployment into repeatable, observable, retryable pipelines. This module covers the general-purpose scheduler most teams start with (Airflow), used for ML pipelines and for data pipelines alongside Dagster, the ML-native orchestrators built around containers and artifacts, and durable execution with Temporal for long-running, event-driven processes.

lessons.title: ML-native orchestrators: Kubeflow Pipelines, Flyte, Prefect and Metaflow
Durable workflows and event-driven services with Temporal
Data pipeline orchestration with Airflow and Dagster
